sampling.policy: Unmodified m1_trace linspace: ceil(duration/configured_dt) intervals, exact stop endpoint

omission_policy: Reuse M1 inactive EMOT and zero-transmitted-power gearbox budgets; their zero values are modelling omissions, NOT measured zero losses. Raw loss calibration remains null/NaN.

thresholds_registered_before_execution.source: M1 numerics point/energy tolerances; m1_sources 1e-7 W; m1_point 1e-6 N feasibility; existing m1_tests/check_outputs kinematic and adhesion tolerances. Exact zero required for disabled regenerative ports.

parameter_sources.vehicle: V0.4 baseline, mixed public dimensional references and S3 concept assumptions
parameter_sources.brake_allocation: Existing M1 ideal equal-adhesion-utilization allocation, not production EBD/ABS
parameter_sources.disc_pad_partition: Unmodified M1 nominal 0.90/0.10; conditional 0.85-0.95 disc enclosure, not measured confidence bounds
parameter_sources.battery_cap: Zero is a scenario disable command, not measured battery acceptance
parameter_sources.partition_winding_temperature_C: Inherited shape-weight parameter only; no physical initial temperature, preheat or temperature feedback is simulated
